# workflow's version) after:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
# Install with:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt -c constraints-divergence.txt

# Why: requirements-dev.txt pins the two reference libraries, but other
# packages change the output too. With exchange_calendars 4.13.2 and
# pandas_market_calendars 5.6.0 both fixed, pandas 3.0.5 and 3.1.1 give
# different exchange_calendars session counts for XBOM and XMOS (session
# 4c-R5). Regenerate this file only together with docs/DIVERGENCE.md.
